Commentary.Commentary: What didn't help the visitors was that Philander couldn't take the field in this session. He was their most economical bowler and mighty effective too. Though Rabada returned with three scalps, he couldn't stop the dangerous Stokes. Morkel was at his best with three wickets too. Morris had an off day today. Join us in a while for the South African innings.

England get to what seemed an unlikely score, when they lost their middle order without great scores. But Stokes, with the help of important contributions from Cook, Bairstow and the debutant Roland-Jones ensured that they pass the 350-run mark. The all-rounder played a top knock to help England post a decent total on board.

OUT! Stokes holes out and that is the end of the innings. A length ball outside off, Stokes backs away and swings hard. All he manages is a top edge which goes straight up in the air. Kagiso Rabada comes running in from long off and completes the formalities. ENGLAND HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 353!
A short ball on middle, pulled through mid-wicket. They realize late that there is a couple available and eventually make it through.
MORNE MORKEL is back on. Faf will want to finish this off now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Banged in short, Ben mistimes his pull through mid-wicket.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely.
Pushes this to long on but does not take the run.
On a length on middle, flicked through square leg for a single.

Excellent bowling. Spots Stokes getting across and fires it down the leg side. Stokes misses his flick and de Kock whips off the bails. Appeals for a stumping but the umpire at square leg is not interested. Stokes never left his crease.
This is well wide outside off, Ben thinks of going after this one too but then lets it go. He asks the umpire about the wide but Aleem Dar shakes his head.
SIX! Make that three in a row! Maharaj keeps looping up the ball and Stokes keeps attacking. Gets down again and mows it over mid-wicket.

SIX! IMPERIOUS! 5TH TEST TON FOR STOKES! He was destined for this, wasn't he? Floated wide outside off, Stokes doesn't care. Gets down, reaches out and slogs it many a mile over long on! He is pumped up, as he takes off his helmet and celebrates his century. What a knock.

CAUGHT BUT SIX! Oh poor Faf. Some luck for Stokes. This is full and outside off, Stokes gets down and mows it over widish long on. Faf du Plessis has placed himself to perfection and the ball travels straight to him. He takes the catch but the momentum takes him back. And he touches the ropes! The umpire checks it upstairs and eventually raises his arms.
Landed outside off, punched down to long on. Does not take the single.
CLOSE SHAVE! On a good length around off, Jimmy feels for it and the ball comes back in a long away. The ball just beats the outside edge.
Full and straight, nicely played back to the bowler. The crowd appreciates that fully, it does want Stokesy to get to his century.
A short ball outside off, Anderson sways away.
JAMES ANDERSON is the last man in. Can he hang around to help Stokes to his ton?

OUT! Edged and taken! Broad walks. Rabada has his third. This dismissal can be attributed to the last over from Rabada. He bowled a lot of short stuff and Broad was perhaps expecting another short one. But this is full and outside off and just swings away a bit. Broad is late in his flick and gets an outside edge which carries nicely to Hashim Amla at first slip who takes it nicely to his right.
Full and down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a run.
Not what the Proteas would have liked. An easy single to Broad. He just tucks this through mid-wicket and kicks off for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover. Broad looks to give Stokes the  strike but is sent back. No run there.

SIX! HUMONGOUS! What a shot that is! That has come from absolutely nowhere. South Africa have 5 fielders at the boundary and three of them are on the leg side. But Stokes backs himself against this flighted delivery outside off, gets down and mows it over long on! And it is dropped in the crowd...
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Goes back and works it through square leg for a single.

IS THAT OUT? Aleem Dar shakes his head. Full and outside off, Broad lunges to defend but misses. The ball goes off the pads to slip and South Africa claim a catch but then do not take the review. Replays detect no inside edge.
'Vernon Philander has been taken to hospital for tests - it appears considerably more serious that the "upset stomach" initially diagnosed' tweets Neil Manthorp. Oh dear...
Full and outside off, pushed straight to point.
Drinks have been taken.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and leg, Stokes pulls that authoritatively. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Not the greatest of ways to end an over by Rabada.
Length ball outside off, played towards point for a single.
Bouncer on middle, Broads picks it early and ducks under that.
Back of a length ball on off, defended from within the crease.
Broad shoulders arms to that ball outside off.
Full ball on off, driven by Stokes through mid off for a run.
Floated on middle and leg, flicked away to the leg side.
Broad defended that loopy ball off the front foot.
Floated on off and middle, Broad defends it on to the ground.
A full toss to welcome Broad, which he can smash it only as far as the cover fielder.
Stuart Broad strides in at the fall of the 8th wicket.

OUT! Maharaj strikes, Toby Roland-Jones is a sitting duck against that ball. That was an arm ball on middle, which skidded through. The batsman prodded forward in defense and missed the ball completely as the ball thudded on to the pads. The South Africans appealed and Aleem Dar raised the dreaded finger. TRJ thought of a review but decided against it. England lose their eighth.
The umpires have got together in the middle and are checking the shape of the ball. The umpires didn't check it with the rings that they generally use to check its shape.
Loopy ball on off, Stokes flicks it away for a single.
Keshav Maharaj to bowl his left arm orthodox.
Fuller ball driven to covers.
FOUR! That's creamed away to the fence by the no.9 batter! It was bowled short on his body, Toby brings out the pulls shot and spanks it disdainfully through square leg for a boundary.
Wonderfully played by the new-comer. That was a yorker on middle and leg, he dug it out well.
Fuller ball defended from within the crease.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Length ball played towards point for a single.
SIX! Ohhh, lucky with a maximum! That was a short ball angling in to Roland-Jones. He swivels and pulls, but ends up getting the top edge. The ball sails high and over fine leg for a biggie.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! That was another length ball on his pads, which the debutant flicks away to the mid-wicket boundary.
Length ball on off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, carved through points for a couple.

FOUR! Punished and how! That was a hit-me ball on his pads, Stokes flicks it away behind square on the leg side and collects a boundary. That's certainly not what you would bowl to a well set batsman.
Fuller ball on off, driven back towards the bowler.
Bouncer on off, Toby doesn't play at that.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Fuller ball on off, driven towards mid off.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT BY A NUMBER 9! That is pitched up outside off upto the batsman, he drives that through mid off with a straight bat. Heino Kuhn from covers tries chasing it, but the ball doesn't delay rushing into the fence.
Length ball outside off, TRJ lets that go.
Similar ball by Morris, this time tucked away to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Poor ball and duly punished! That was a length ball on his pads angling down the leg side. All Roland-Jones had to do was get bat to ball, which he did, and collected a boundary through fine leg.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

What was that! Short ball outside off, Stokes tries to fetch that and play it on the on side, albeit with a half mind. He ends up getting it off the toe end of the bat and the ball lobs towards mid off aerially. They take a quick run.
Bowled on a good length outside off, stokes doesn't bother playing.
Length ball outside off, Stokes goes for the swish and misses.
Chris Morris into the attack now.
Full and down the leg side, the debutant tries to flick and misses.
Bouncer on off and middle, TRJ ducks under that.
Back of a length ball on off, Stokes collects a single by playing it on the off side.
Fuller ball on off, Ben defends it off the back foot.
Again Stokes shoulders arms to that length ball outside off.
Length ball outside off, Stokes lets that one go.
Roland-Jones gets going in Tests with a flick towards square leg for a couple.
Toby lets that ball outside off go through the keeper.
Back of a length ball hits Stokes on the thigh pad. They cross over for a leg bye.
Another ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, Stokes lets that go to the keeper.
Length ball on off and middle, that stayed low as Stokes got squared up, the ball took the edge and went to the off side.
Another leave by Toby to a length ball outside off.
Length ball outside off has been offered no shot.
Full on middle and off, Roland-Jones defends it off the front foot.
Debutant Toby Roland-Jones walks in at the fall of the 7th wicket.

OUT! Excellent review by the Proteas! The on field decision gets reversed. Moeen Ali's stay at the crease comes to an end. Morkel was bowling probing lines, Ali couldn't help but had to play at that. A good length ball outside off and coming into him, he looks to defend off the front foot. The ball passes from the inside half of the bat, hits his pads and goes through to de Kock. The South Africans appeal for a caught behind, which the onfield umpire Joel Wilson denies. The Proteas go upstairs, and Ultra Edge shows a spike as the ball passes the bat. The spike could have been because of the bat hitting the pads, too. The third umpire rules in the bowler's favour and Ali is ruled out caught behind. England lose their seventh. The visitors get the breakthrough that they wanted.
A caught behind decision is referred upstairs. The umpire gave it not out, but the South Africans seemed convinced and opted for a review.
Good length outside off, Ali gets beaten as he tries to drive that towards mid off.
Back of a length ball from round the wicket on off, the ball hits MA high on his thigh and lobs towards the slip cordon.
Length ball on off, Ali plays it to the left of covers. They take one before the mid off fielder gets to the ball.
Ali has to face some chin music here. Bouncer on off and middle, Ali sways away from the line.
Bowled on a good length on off, Stokes looked to play it towards covers. The extra bounce meant that the ball hit him high on the bat and went to the right of covers for a single.
Back of a length on off, Ali jumps and plays it with soft hands besides the pitch towards point. They cross over for a quick single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Moeen lets that through to the keeper.
Full ball on middle and leg, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Bowled short from around the wicket on middle and leg, Ali ducks under it.
Short ball, going harmlessly outside the off stump, Ali points the bat skywards and lets it go.
That's a bumper on middle. Ali ducks under it.
Length ball outside off, played through point for a single.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, driven back to the bowler. He gets a hand to it and the ball rolls over besides the pitch. Ali was backing up and rushed to make it in.
Length ball on off, driven towards mid off. No run there.
Slight drizzle at the moment.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Moeen punches that through covers off the back foot. They collect two before the fielder stops that and returns the throw.
Fuller ball but outside off, Ali lets that go to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Ali doesn't bother playing at that.
Back of length ball outside leg, Stokes flicks it away backward of square of the leg side for a run.
Straight on middle, Stokes plays it from within the crease.
Good length ball on off, Ali wanted to glide it towards third man. The ball took the edge and went towards point, where a misfield by Morris allowed them a single.
Kagiso Rabada with figures of 60-2 to bowl from the other end.
Fractionally fuller this time, Ali collects a single through covers.
Bowled on a length on off, driven to mid off.
Bouncer! But not well directed. Ali ducks under it and lets it go the keeper.
Length ball on off, Ali defends showing the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball on off, pushed to the cover region.
Length ball outside off, Ali shoulders arms.

The players and the umpires have made their way out. Ben Stokes and Moeen Ali would look to do the run scoring. Morne Morkel to start off with the ball. South Africa would look to get that early breakthrough, which would enable them to bowl to the tail.
... DAY TWO, SESSION TWO ...

For the Proteas, Philander could be unfit to take field for the day as per reports. So that could be a blow to them, as he has looked incisive throughout his spell. Stokes and Ali would look to score big post lunch, while du Plessis' troop would scratch their minds to get rid of the English all-rounder. Join us in a while for what could be another exciting session.

This session went a tad towards England as they scored 98 runs in 27 overs for the loss of Cook and Bairstow. It started off with Cook and Stokes resuming their vigil. Cook departed without another century to his name. Stokes has looked in terrific touch so far today, and these are ominous signs for South Africa. Bairstow looked fluent while he was out there, but he was dismissed due to the customary movement of the second new ball.
Half volley outside off, Ali drives it through cover-point. Maharaj who is at covers, gives a spirited chase, gets in the slide and saves a run for his side. THAT'S LUNCH, DAY TWO.
Good length on middle, defended off the back foot from within the crease.
Temba Bavuma is stationed at short leg.
Full ball on leg, it hits Ali low on his pads as he misses his flick.
Length ball on middle and leg, played towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Ali looked to shoulder arms, but was late in doing so. The ball took the edge of the bat and went past the second slip and into the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length ball just outside off, Stokes gets beaten.
Length ball on middle and leg, played towards mid-wicket for a run.

Back of length ball on middle and off, Ali looks to fend that. The ball takes the inside edge and hits his back thigh and goes on the bounce to the keeper. The impact on the thigh reduced the speed of the ball, which saved him there.
That's bowled well wide of the off stump, Ali leaves it alone.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, played to mid on.
Bouncer on middle, Ali ducks and lets it go.
That's bowled outside off, the batsman fails to get bat on to that.
Back of a length ball on his pads, flicked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the front foot.
That one's wide of the off stump and Ali leaves it alone.
Low full toss on middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
Short ball down the leg side, Ali misses the flick and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Full ball on leg, flicked away behind square leg for a single.
Ali's troubles against bouncers is well documented, and he ducks under this one.
Stokes gets an inside edge onto his pads of the length ball. As the ball rolls over to the off side, they run one.
Length ball on middle, defended off the front foot by Ben.
Bowled further up to the batsman, he plays it off the front foot into the ground.
Full ball outside off, Stokes shoulders arms.
Length ball on off, played away towards point.
Full on middle and leg, played away to mid-wicket.
The bearded Moeen Ali comes in next. England would love a significant knock from him.

OUT! RABADA STRIKES WITH THE SECOND NEW CHERRY! Back of a length ball just outside off, nibbling away from the batter. Bairstow gets squared up as he hangs out his bat. The ball takes the outside edge and travels towards second slip. Du Plessis there takes a good low catch to his left to end Bairstow's stay at the crease. England in a spot of bother now as Rabada gets his second.
Length ball on middle, driven to mid on.
Shortish ball outside off, Bairstow fends. The ball takes the outside half of the bat and runs towards the third man fence. Before Morkel chases it down, they complete a brace.
Back of a length ball outside off, Bairstow punched that off the back foot straight to extra cover.
Kagiso Rabada will share the second new ball from the other end.
Full on middle, played back to the bowler. Maiden over, the first one with the second new ball.
Fuller ball outside off, BS leaves that alone.
Back of length ball outside off, Stokes doesn't bother playing that. This carries at a good height to the keeper.
This one's bowled fuller outside off, Stokes shoulders arms. It went on a bounce to de Kock.
Full out swinging delivery too wide of off to draw a stroke from Stokes.
Full outside off and a slight hint of in swing, Stokes lets that go to the keeper.
Morne Morkel to start off with the second new ball.
The second new ball is available now and THEY HAVE TAKEN IT.
Full and around middle and off, watchfully blocked out.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, a touch short, punched straight to cover.
Lesser flight, this time BS goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
A little bit of flight now, Ben comes down the track and pushes it towards short cover.
Landed around off, Stokes stays back and defends.
Outside off, left alone.
This time he gets his tuck right and earns a single.
This is down the leg side, Stokes looks to tuck it away but misses. There seemed to be a noise as the ball went past but no one appealed.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angles this away from the left-hander, outside off, Stokes lets it go.
On a length on middle and leg, swinging in, flicked straight to Temba Bavuma at short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Punches this down to long on for a single.
Tossed up a bit, Stokes, who is looking to size up Maharaj, comes down the track but is not to the pitch of the ball and defends.
Full and around off, pushed down to Kagiso Rabada at long on for a run.
Full again, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, swept powerfully through mid-wicket. Chris Morris makes a good sliding stop at the boundary. A single taken.
Outside off, tapped through point for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Clips this through mid-wicket for a single.
CHRIS MORRIS is back on.

Oohh... very close. The ball is full on middle and Bairstow looks to sweep it fine again. He just about manages to get a bit of glove and the ball goes behind, past the diving slip who tries to stop it. A single taken.
Tossed up outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Landed around off, watchfully patted forward.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This is an arm ball, darted down the leg side, Bairstow looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pad.
Full on middle, flicked through square leg.
Good length delivery outside off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Pushes this towards point again but now it is only a single.
Good running. Again back of a length outside off, Jonny taps it behind point. Two, he says and then runs excellently to come back for the second.
FOUR! Amazing stroke. Back of a length ball outside off, Bairstow waits on his back foot and crunches it behind point. Not a soul moved as that ball raced away.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

That is an excellent fielding effort from Morkel! Down the leg side, Stokes tucks it through backward square leg. The ball races to the fence but Morne Morkel gives it a good chase, gets to the ball and then dives to pull it in. He himself has to run in and throw the ball, so the third is taken.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
10th Test fifty for Stokes.

FOUR! JUST OVER! Looks like he is in the mood, Stokes. A short ball outside off, Stokes just stands still and wallops it over mid on. Does not quite middle it, the ball goes off the toe end of the bat and is aerial. Dean Elgar leaps at mid on but the ball eludes him. Had there been a taller player, Stokes could have been gone. Anyways, it is a half century for Stokes. It is also the 50-run stand.
On a length around off, Stokes  stays back and defends.
Change of ends for Rabada.

DRINKS are on the field. Even though England lost Cook to a pacy ball by Morkel, they have continued to rake in the runs, courtesy Stokes and Bairstow. The Protea bowlers found no way to defeat Stokes, and that should be the main worry in Faf's mind, as the all-rounder can take the game away in a flash.

FOUR! Another sweep in the over results in another boundary. Flighted ball on middle and leg, he plays that shot and the ball races to the fine leg fence. Even though he has been dismissed thrice by this bowler in the series, Bairstow is taking the attack to the spinner here.
Loopy ball on off, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter ball on middle, solidly defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Not entirely in control this time, yet effective. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Jonny charges down and hits it to the right of the bowler for another boundary. He didn't seem to get to the pitch of the ball on that occasion.

FOUR! Sweeps and sweeps hard! Floated on middle and off, Bairstow hits that powerfully through backwards square leg for a boundary. The key was to watch the ball till the end and stay in control of the shot, which he was.
Loopy ball on middle, driven towards mid on. No run there.

Spin for the first time today in the form of Keshav Maharaj. This seems to be a good move from Faf du Plessis. Bairstow has struggled against Maharaj this series, getting out to him 3 times out of 4. He has not quite picked him yet.
Length ball on his pads, he fails to get bat on that. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls towards fine leg.
FOUR! Would love to watch that shot on loop! That was an outswinger outside off, full enough to invite a drive. Bairstow drives it powerfully through covers for a boundary.
Fuller ball on middle, driven to mid on.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Short ball on middle and leg pulled away towards fine leg where Rabada fields. They cross over for a single.
Fuller ball on off, Stokes defends and the ball takes the inside edge of his bat and strikes his pads.
A play and miss by Jonny of that length ball outside off.
Fuller ball outside off punched towards covers off the back foot.
Back of a length ball outside off climbing at the batsman. Bairstow fends it and gloves it which goes on the bounce to gully.
Length ball outside off, punched away defensively on the off side.
Full ball on middle, Stokes flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball on middle and leg, Jonny flicks it through square leg for a run.
Kagiso Rabada is brought in to bowl now.
Length ball on off, defended from within the crease. A very productive over for England.

FOUR! And again! Third in the over and Stokes has taken a liking to Morris here. Another full ball outside off, Ben drives it through mid off for yet another boundary. He is looking in great touch out there.
Good yorker on off, Stokes manages to dig it out.
FOUR! Aah! Beauty! Full on middle and leg, Stokes just times that and pushes it through mid on. The ball races away for yet another boundary. Stokes is good with his timing today.
FOUR! Crisp and classy cover drive by Ben! Full outside off, Stokes gets his front foot forward and drives it to the cover fence for a boundary.
Full ball on off, Stokes drives it down towards mid off.
Chris Morris to bowl for the first time today. Meanwhile Philander walks off the field yet again.
Length ball outside off and seaming away. Bairstow pokes his bat tentatively as the ball passes the outside edge.
Full ball outside off, JB gets a bottom edge as he tries playing it towards the off side.
Length ball swinging away from the off stump, Jonny leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, Bairstow shoulders arms.
Full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! Glorious shot that. Philander bowls it full outside off, Bairstow times it perfectly through covers for a boundary. This shot makes it seem that he is batting there for a long time.
Length ball on off, Stokes defends from the front foot.
Another straight drive, but back to the bowler. No run there.
Drives that full ball straight down towards mid off.
Length ball on off, hits Stokes on his pads and they take two leg byes.

Another good looking shot that fetches him a couple. Full ball on off and middle, driven straight down the ground. Morkel gets some hand to that which enables Kuhn, who was at mid off, to chase it and keep it to two.
FOUR! Ben STOKES that away for a boundary! Short ball outside off, he brings out the pull shot, clubs it towards mid-wicket and into the fence. He looked completely in command of that shot.
Fuller ball on off, driven back to the bowler. That was swinging away a tad.
Back of length ball on middle, played towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, JB lets it go.
Length ball outside off, Jonny raises his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball on middle gets Bairstow going as he flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full ball on leg and middle, Stokes flicks it away for a run.

Philander is back on. Must have popped in a couple of tablets. Aha... interesting. Aleem Dar signals towards the third umpire that his walkie-talkie is not working. He asks for a new one. It has not come yet...
Length ball outside off, JB leaves it alone.
Good length ball outside off, Bairstow avoids trouble by not making any contact with that.
Length ball outside off, Jonny shoulders arms.
Bairstow is welcomed to the crease with a bouncer which he leaves alone.
Jonny Bairstow walks in at the fall of the 5th wicket.

OUT! The third umpire upholds the onfield call. Morkel starts round the wicket and bowls it on a length on off. Cook gets beaten for pace and gets struck on the pads. He hops on to the back foot and misses the ball as he tries to defend it. A loud appeal results in the umpire raising the dreaded finger. Cook reviews immediately, and umpires' call on the impact as the ball clipped the bails on the ball tracker means that the batsman has to depart! Cook departs for 88, England lose half their side. The 63-run stand is broken.
Morkel strikes! He has pinned Cook in front but the latter has reviewed it. Height seems to be a factor there...
Short ball, pulled away for a run.
Philander walks off the field again. Is it the same stomach bug that troubled him yesterday? He should be back on field within 2 minutes to be able to bowl the next over.

Interesting discussion from the cricketing greats on air. Shane Warne feels that Keaton Jennings is not a busy cricketer, not looking for singles and only looks to survive. Nasser Hussain reckons that is because Jennings is not that confident. Then, as a proper headmaster overseeing his teaching staff, David Lloyd puts his thoughts into words. He recounts that century by Jennings against India. Says that there, the southpaw used to keep his head down, used to meet the ball, come forward and LOOK TO PLAY. Since then, his head has been absolutely still and he has preferred to meet the ball off the pitch, than come forward and ease it into gaps. Nice discussion.
Lovely ball by Philander. Back of a length ball on middle, swings away late. Cook gets beaten as he poked his bat at it.
Length ball outside off, Cook lets it go.
Good length ball outside off, the batsman doesn't bother fiddling with that.
Length ball on off, the batsman pushes it towards covers.
Lovely ball outside off, Cook pokes his bat at it and gets beaten.
Length ball on middle and leg, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball outside off, Stokes gets a bottom edge on that one.
That's the signature Cook cover drive. It was bowled full outside off, he brings out that stride and plays the shot. Kuhn chases down and saves a run for the side.
Length ball outside off, Cook lets it go.
The batter defends that length ball from within the crease.
Length ball on off, Cook defends off the back foot.
Length ball on off, Cooky plays it to mid-wicket for no run.

2000 Test runs for Ben Stokes. Becomes the 57th English player to achieve this feat. Just his 62nd inning in Tests. The average is pretty decent, around 33 while his strike rate is around 63. He just needs to start becoming more consistent to improve that average.
FOUR! Glorious shot to get to 2000 Test runs by Stokes. That was bowled full on middle and leg, he flicked that towards mid-wicket and the chasing fielders didn't stand a chance to cut that off.
Back of a length ball on leg, Alastair takes a single in front of square on the leg side.
Length ball on off, Cooky plays it towards gully.
Length ball on off, Cook blocks it towards point.
Fuller ball on off, Cook defends it towards covers.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Cook just had to play at that one. Back of a length ball on middle and off, seaming away from the batter, he prods his bat in defense. The ball takes the outside edge and lands agonizingly short of a diving du Plessis at second slip.
Full ball on off, Stokes plays it straight to mid off. Maiden to begin with for Morkel.
Full outside off, Ben shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes stays away from it by leaving it alone.
Length ball bowled on off and middle, Stokes plays it towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Stokes raises the bat in the air and lets it go through.
Bowling round the wicket, he bowls it on a length off, Stokes pushes it towards covers.
Morne Morkel to run in from the other end.
Back of length ball on middle and leg, the former skipper pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Speared in fuller on off, Cook pushes it towards mid off, no run there.
Length ball on his pads, Cook flicks it behind square on the leg side and collects a brace.
Fuller ball on middle and off, Cook blocks it towards point.
Straight ball, full on middle, Cook pushes it defensively back to the bowler.
Starts of with a back of a length ball on legs, Stokes tucks it away through backward square leg to get underway.
Alastair Cook and Ben Stokes are the men who saw the English side to stumps, and they walk out to resume their innings. Vernon Philander will steam in for South Africa with the ball. Here we go...

England were on the back foot after losing Jennings early. Then Cook and Westley consolidated well with a half century stand. The former skipper has played cautiously so far, and even though they have batting to come in the form of Bairstow, Ali and Broad, the home team would love Cook and Stokes to continue as long as they can. Expect a tug-of-war between bat and ball which should engage the cricketing fans world over!

The Proteas showed intent from ball one, and the only mild concern, if any, they had was Philander's stomach bug that made him leave the field a couple of times. They would hope to carry on the steady barrage of disciplined and, if possible, lethal stuff with the ball.

Hola everyone! Welcome to our coverage of Day Two of the third riveting contest between England and South Africa. Day One saw only 59 overs of play being possible before rain prevented further play. The home side is precariously placed owing to a steady stream of dismissals triggered by some disciplined and threatening South African bowling.
... DAY TWO, SESSION ONE ...

The day overall belonged to South Africa, as even after winning the toss and choosing to bat, the hosts aren't really in as strong a position as they would have liked. None of their top order batsmen, apart from Cook, showed application to put up a decent score. The visitors were on the money with the ball from the beginning. Loose balls came too far and few. Their fielding was up to the mark. All points to England playing the catch up game at the end of Day One. The exciting game would resume tomorrow at 1100 local time (1000 GMT) for the start of the second day's play. Till then, Adios!

1819 LOCAL TIME UPDATE - Rain has stopped. The umpires are out there inspecting. It's still pretty dark and cloudy out there though. Groundsmen have a task at hand to mop up the field.

1800 LOCAL TIME UPDATE - Bad news folks! The rain has arrived yet again. The players are ambling back to their dressing rooms. Stay tuned for more updates...
This one is defended from within the crease to end the over.

Length ball on middle and off defended off the back foot by the batter.

50-run stand up between Cook and Stokes.

Fuller ball on middle and leg, Stokes gets it off the inner half through square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, it seams away a bit. It goes past Stokes' bat that was poked there.

Full ball on middle and off, BS defends it off the front foot.

That was outside off and well left by the former skipper.
Full on off, Cook plays it towards point.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and angled down the leg side, Cook nudges it fine off his hips. That's delicately played as the ball runs down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, Stokes plays it towards fine leg for a run.
Full and too wide to make Stokes play.
Length ball on leg, flicked away to fine leg for a run.

Beaten. That was a back of a length ball on off, passes the outside edge of his bat.

EDGED AND FOUR! Back of length ball outside off and angling away from Stokes. He slashes and slashes hard. The ball takes the outside edge and flies over the slip cordon and through to the third man fence. No half measures from Stokes on that occasion.
Full ball on middle and leg, Ben plays it towards mid-wicket for no run.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Stokes misses the flick.
Wide! That is too wide outside off. the umpire signals a wide.
Wonderful ball to end the over. Full out swinger on off stump. It draws Cook forward and teasingly misses the outside edge.
Another full and wide delivery to which AC shoulders arms.
Length ball well outside off to trouble Alastair.
Fuller ball on off, batsman defends it from within the crease.
Length ball on off, Cook bunts that off the back foot.
Morkel bowls it well outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
Full ball on off, Stokes defends.

A peach! Unlucky to not get a wicket off that. Good length on off and straightening after pitching, Stokes strides forward to defend. The ball beats him on the inside and just goes over the off stump. Wonderful ball that.
Full outside off, the batsman lets that go through to the keeper.
Full on off, Stokes pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller ball on off, Stokes strides forward in defense. The ball takes the inside edge and goes to fine leg and they run a brace.
Back of length down the leg side, Stokes misses the flick and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Vernon Philander with figures 9-5-8-2 to bowl from the other end.
Back of length outside off, batsman shoulders arms.
Length ball on middle and leg, Cook defends off the back foot.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, pulled away towards fine leg for a single.

Back of length ball outside off and swinging away, Stokes shoulders arms.
The men who matter have made their way out in the middle. 31 overs are scheduled for the session. Play can be extended to 1930 local time. Morkel to start with the ball now.
1658 LOCAL TIME UPDATE - Play is scheduled to resume at 1730 local time, provided the rains keep away.
1635 LOCAL TIME UPDATE - The final session should have got underway by now, but rains have delayed the proceedings.

The ex-English skipper has looked the most composed of the lot and is unbeaten on 72. He needs support from Stokes. Promising partnerships need to be converted to something substantial to get the visitors thinking. Join us for the evening session as and when the weather permits.

After that, Root joined Cook in the middle and battled it out with a 49-run stand. Morkel kept on bowling nagging lines and lengths and tested the former in particular. It was a shaky innings from the English skipper who looked unsettled and eventually departed. The left-handed debutant, Malan got a peach from Rabada and was sent packing.

Time for Tea and it has started raining as well. It has gone really dark but let's hope the wind blows the clouds away. Coming back to the game, it has been a really good session for South Africa. They have managed to pick up three wickets along with keeping the run rate in check. Right after lunch, Morris removed the debutant, Westley with a beautiful delivery.
Very full on middle and leg, Cook plays it towards mid-wicket. It was almost like the one that got Malan, the only difference being this was a tad fuller. THAT'S TEA, DAY ONE!
Yorker outside off, Cook digs it out on the off side.
Full and swinging down the leg, Stokes misses the flick. The ball hits his pads and they collect a leg bye towards square leg.
Length ball defended off the back foot.
Shortish ball on leg, Stokes swivels and pulls it to the right of fine leg. Before he fields and returns the throw, they take a brace.
Well kept de Kock! Rabada steams in and sprays that ball full down the leg side. The keeper dives to his right and stops that. Not a clean take but effective nevertheless.
Length ball outside off, Cook covers the stumps and leaves it alone.
Full and wide ball outside off, Cook doesn't bother fiddling with that.
Shortish ball on off, Cook punches it off the back foot.

FOUR! Shot! Again a good length ball on off moves in laterally after pitching. Cook is so well set, that he rides that movement and pushes it through mid on and collects a boundary. That looked as glorious as it can get.
Full ball on off, Stokes clobbers it straight to the cover fielder, who misfields and concedes a run.
Length ball punched off the back foot for a run.
Length ball on middle and leg, Cook plays it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
Again Cook shoulders arms to a length ball outside off.
Length ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.

NOT OUT! Back of a length ball on off, Stokes punches it off the back foot through cover-point. Bavuma chases it down and throws it towards the bowler's end where the player takes down the stumps as Stokes dives in to complete the third run. It is referred upstairs. The replays show that for a moment Stokes' bat was in the air but he did well to get it down in time. They get three.
Run out appeal against Stokes is referred upstairs by Aleem Dar.
Good length ball going across Stokes who shoulders arms to that one.
The lateral movement off the pitch for Morris increased as the over progressed. Back of length ball outside off and came into Cook as he defended it awkwardly off the back foot.
Another back of length ball outside off and coming into the batsman. Cook defends off the back foot.
Shortish ball outside off, moving in after pitching. Cook bunts it on to the ground.
Good length ball on his pads, Stokes flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball closer to stumps, but not close enough to make him play.
Runs in and bowls a full ball wide of off stump, Stokes says I won't play that!
Length ball on off, Cook stays tall and defends it on the off side.
Back of a length ball on middle and going away, Cook shoulders arms.
Fuller ball on off, Stokes plays it to the right of mid off and they cross over for a run.
Length ball on middle, Cook picks up a run towards mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, Stokes mistimes the push down the ground for a single.

Wow! What a shot. That's a half volley outside off, he gets that stride in and brings out the Cook-special cover drive. Maharaj chases that down and keeps the ball in play. The umpires check it upstairs and he is fine. Saves a run for his side.
Short ball on middle, Cook crisply pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Full ball on middle, Cook bunts it off the front foot.
Short ball on middle, Cook pulls it towards square leg.
Length ball outside off, played through backward point for a couple.
Back of a length ball on leg, Stokes plays it towards fine leg for a single to get off the mark.
Fuller ball outside off, Stokes leaves it alone.
Morris back into the attack after his initial burst of 8 overs.

FOUR! Shortish ball going away from the batsman, Cook punches that wonderfully through covers for a boundary. Such a sweet timer of the ball is this guy, that one just wonders where he was in the previous match.
Good length ball duly defended by Cook.
Length ball outside off, Cook lets it go.
Length ball defended off the front foot by the batter.
Back of length ball outside off, the batsman gets beaten.
Length ball down the leg side, Cook leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, Stokes plays it to point.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Stokes flicks it off his pads.
Length ball on off, Stokes pushes it off the front foot.
Back of length ball on leg, Stokes gets hit on his thigh pads.
Full ball on middle and leg, played off the front foot for no run.
Full ball on middle and leg flicked away for a single.
All-rounder Ben Stokes walks in next.

OUT! JAFFA! What a delivery to get on your debut. Unlucky Dawid Malan! That was a fast spearing yorker ball on middle and leg, Malan was just a tad late in getting his bat down and he fell over as the ball crashed on to the stumps. It was an almost-unplayable ball. Rabada and the entire African side is pumped up, and why not! Such deliveries are a rarity in cricket. England in trouble here.
Full and quick delivery down the leg side, Malan misses the flick and the ball thuds into de Kock's gloves.
Length ball on middle and leg, Cook plays it towards mid on for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, AC lets it go.
Length ball outside off, well left by Cooky.

Malan gets going in Test cricket after 15 balls! Back of a length ball on off, he defends it off the back foot towards point and sets off for a quick single. The throw from the fielder hit Malan as he completed that run. So a painful way to get going that!
Lovely delivery to follow that boundary ball. Length ball on middle swings away from the batsman beating his outside edge.
55th Test fifty for the former England skipper, Alastair Cook.
FOUR! And he gets to his half century in style. Shortish ball outside off, Cook plays the cut shot in style and through point for a boundary.
Woah! That's an outswinger on middle and off drawing Cook forward. It passes the outside edge of the bat.
Back of length ball outside off, Cook trying to cut, gets a thick bottom edge making the ball bounce on the ground.

Good length ball on middle played by Cook to mid-wicket.

Good length ball on off, going across Malan. He has nothing to do with that.

Length ball on leg, tucked to the on side.

Full ball on off, Cook plays it uppishly towards point. It fell just short of the fielder there.
Fuller ball on off, Cook plays it onto the ground.

APPEAL BY THE PROTEAS! Not out says the umpire. That was a back of a length ball on leg, it hurried on to Cook, and struck him on his pads. Height was the factor that denied a wicket to the South Africans.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Cook blocks that towards the bowler.
Length ball on middle, Cook pushes it defensively towards mid-wicket.

Floated on off and middle, Malan defends it on the leg side.
Malan has some issue with the sightscreen.
Loops it on off, Malan pushes it with the turn towards mid-wicket.

1507 LOCAL TIME UPDATE - Good news folks! The rain has stopped and the covers have been peeled off from the ground. The match is scheduled to start again at 1515 local time.

1453 LOCAL TIME UPDATE - Oh no! The rain has arrived again. Up go the umbrellas in the crowd as the groundsmen come rushing in with the covers. The good thing is that there is a strong breeze blowing across and lets hope it blows the shower away along with it.
Floated ball on off, Malan shimmies down and hits it straight back to Maharaj.

Philander once again stops in his delivery stride.

Debutant and Middlesex middle order batsman Dawid Malan walks into the center with England in a spot of bother. Third slip also in place for him.

OUT! Gone! Root has to depart! Philander bowls it back of a length on off, seaming away from the skipper. Root had to, just had to play at that and he does. The ball takes the outside edge and Quinton de Kock snaffles up a stunner. He was moving towards his left looking at the angle of the ball, but quickly recovered and dived to his right to catch that. Terrific bowling, terrific catching to get rid of one of the best batsmen in world cricket. The pressure that Morkel built has had a telling effect on Root's mindset and has led to this dismissal. Vernon gets his second wicket. Another promising partnership for England comes to an end.
Back of length ball on middle and leg, Cook takes a run by flicking it to deep square leg.
Tossed up on middle and off, Root defends it off the front foot.

Loopy ball defended off the front foot.

Loopy ball on off, Root drives it to cover.
Swerving good length ball on off and middle, Cook defends off the front foot. The ball hits the inside edge and hits his pads and falls on the ground.
Length ball on middle, Joe looks to play with soft hands but gets hit on his pads and the ball rolls towards square leg for a quick leg bye.
Bowled fuller outside off, Root tried to play it towards covers, but the ball went of the inside edge of the bat towards mid on.
Good length ball outside off, Root covers his stumps and shoulders arms.

Bowled on a good length on off and middle, Root defends it towards  mid-wicket.

DRINKS has been taken. A good passage of play for South Africa. Morkel is in the midst of a great spell and is troubling the English skipper. Keshav Maharaj from the other hand has been steady and is getting some good purchase from the track. They need to keep building the pressure to bring about the breakthrough. England on the other hand need to be calm and composed in their approach to keep the scoreboard ticking.
Fuller on off, played with soft hands to mid on.
Flatter this time, Cook blocks it.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
A bit short this time, Cook goes back and tucks it past the right side of the leg gully fielder. Two runs taken.

Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Cook goes for the cut but gets beaten again. He is living dangerously.
Shortish delivery but way outside off, Root doesn't fiddle with it. Three maidens in a row. Good stuff from the Proteas.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length delivery around off, Root shuffles and defends it solidly.

Length delivery shaping in from outside off, Root goes for the clip but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. The players are all upbeat and are putting pressure on the English skipper. It is not easy to get on top of one of the best batsman in Test cricket.
Risky! Maharaj drags his length back. Cook rocks back and goes for the cut but gets beaten. Perhaps that was too close to cut.
Lunges forward to this one and defends it.
Tossed up around off, Alastair pushes at it tentatively but gets an inside edge towards past short leg.
Floated outside off, Cook works it to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Floated outside off, turning in sharply. Cook decides to pad it away. A confident shout for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved. The replays show that it was not turning back enough.
Length delivery tailing in sharply. Root is beaten on the tuck and wears it on his thigh pad. Great testing maiden over.
Jaffa! Fulish delivery outside off, Root goes for an ambitious drive down the ground but the ball shapes away to whiz past his outside edge.
This is great bowling from Morkel. Bowls this one on a fullish length outside off and draws Root into the drive. He gets beaten.
This one jags back in sharply from outside off, Root covers his off stump and lets it go. De Kock once again fails to collect the ball in his gloves.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Joe initially looks to leave it alone but feels for it eventually. He is lucky to have not nicked that. The ball seamed away late that time.
Beaten! Length delivery outside off, Root goes deep in the crease to counter it but is beaten comprehensively.
In line of the stumps, stays a touch low. Cook manages to keep it out.
Joe stays back and places it towards point. Good judgement of the single as they complete it with ease.
Maharaj drags his length back, Root hangs back and punches it to short cover.
Slower through the air, Joe puts a big stride forward and pats it to the off side.
Stays back to the shorter delivery and pushes it to short cover.
Tossed up delivery, Root prods forward to defend it.
Cook nudges this one towards mid on.

Close shave! Length delivery on off, Cook camps back and pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge. Elgar dives full length to his right but the ball falls just short of him. This is good bowling from Morkel.
Wide outside off this time as Cook makes an easy leave.

Four Byes! That was a peach! Back of a length on off, seams away substantially after landing. Cook feels for it but is beaten all ends up. De Kock tries to collect it over his head but it goes through. It also rolls down to the fence behind. Four byes signaled by the umpire.
On the shorter side of things but way outside off. Cook is no mood to flirt with it.
Good length delivery shaping in from outside off. Root uses the depth of the crease to place it to point. A run taken.
Slow through the air on middle, worked to short mid-wicket.
Prods forward to the floated delivery and blocks it.
Drifting in with the arm from outside off, Root pushes at it tentatively and gets a thick inside edge past Bavuma at short leg. A single taken.
Well bowled! Tossed up on middle, spinning away a touch. Joe is opened up in his stance as he gets it off the outer half to short third man.
Floated outside off, holding its line. Root plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Cook nudges it through mid-wicket for an easy single. 100 up for England and it is met with a good cheer from the crowd!
Keshav Maharaj comes back into the attack. Meanwhile, Atherton, on air, informs us that Philander is out of the field owing to his upset stomach.
Length delivery outside off, seaming away after pitching. Root stays back and allows it through.

FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short but it is going down the leg side, Root gets into a good position and helps it on its way. Rabada moves swiftly to his right and dives but in vain. A boundary results!
This one jags back sharply from a good length. Root is hurried by it as he brings his bat down but only manages to get an inside edge onto his thigh pad.
Morris is getting good movement but he needs to maintain cosistent lines and lengths. Bowls this on a shortish length outside off, Joe punches it nicely through cover-point. Two runs taken.
That's a great delivery! Almost trapped the English skipper there. Hurls this on a driving length outside off. Root is drawn into an expansive stroke but the ball moves away to beat his outside edge.
Morris loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Root goes for the clip but misses it.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Cook shuffles across and watches it go through into the gloves of de Kock.
Similar length delivery on off, Alastair puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Fuller length ball on off, Cook plants his front foot across and dabs it to the point fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, angling in. Alastair leaves it alone.
In the channel outside off, shaping in a touch. The ex-English skipper shuffles a touch, ensures he has his stumps covered and makes a watchful leave.
Length delivery angling in towards the hips, Cook makes use of the crease and clips it through mid-wicket. Collects an easy couple.

Another short delivery but this one is going down the leg side, Alastair is hurried a bit but manages to pull it down to fine leg. Rabada moves across to his left and slides to make a good stop. A run taken.
Shortish delivery, climbing on Cook. He hops and tucks it towards square leg.
Full and angling down the leg side, Root clips it beautifully through mid-wicket. Morris sprints after it and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
Morris searches for some swing again and ends up bowling a half-volley outside off, Root drives it crisply through mid off for a brace.

Cook clips this fullish delivery towards mid-wicket and sets off. Morkel comes across to it and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. There was a bit of confusion in the running but no harm done.
FOUR! Easy pickings! If you keep bowling there to him, he will keep punishing you all day. Swinging into the pads, Cook tickles it fine past the keeper and through to the fine leg fence.
Wide! Morris hurls this one way outside off on a shorter length and it swings further way. Cook doesn't bother to play at it. Wide signaled by the umpire.
A bit short outside off this time, not enough room to draw Root into the cut shot as he lets it be. A maiden for Morkel.
The English skipper knows where his off stump is and makes another good leave to a similar delivery.
In the corridor of uncertainty, seaming in a bit. Root covers his off stump and leaves it alone.
Length delivery angling in substantially this time. Root falls over a bit as he look to clip it away but is pinged on the thigh pad.
In the channel outside off, Joe points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Shortish delivery outside off, Root initially hangs his bat out towards it but leaves it alone in the end.
Back of a length ball outside off, Root defends it towards cover-point off the back foot and takes a run.
Length ball outside off, Joe gets beaten.

FOUR! Streaky yet lucky! Fuller ball outside off, Root pokes his bat at that. But the good thing he did there was play it with soft hands. The ball took the edge and went on two bounces to the right of du Plessis at second slip, the second being an awkward bounce, and ran away into the third man fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Classy shot. Short ball just outside off, Root watches it till the end, opens his bat face and guides it between slip and gully for a boundary. Looking at that shot, one would think that he was batting out there all day long.
Back of a length ball, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Full ball outside off, Cook defends it towards gully.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Root doesn't let it go unpunished. He cuts and cuts hard through point for a boundary. That would get him going.
Back of length ball outside off, it took the inside edge, struck Root high on the thigh and rolled over to gully.
Back of a length ball outside off, slightly swinging away, doesn't invoke any interest from Root who leaves it alone.
Full swinging ball outside off, Root shows the full face of the bat and plays it towards covers.
Full swinging ball that pitched on leg and swung even more away. De Kock dived and got his gloves, but couldn't prevent the bye.
Length ball outside off, Cooks lets that go to the keeper.
Morkel to bowl from the other end.
Full and down the leg side, Root misses the flick and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Skipper Joe Root strides out in the middle.

OUT! The break does it for South Africa! And it was a peach of a delivery outside off. Full outswinger inviting the drive and Westley falls for that. He opts for the shot without much feet movement and ends up nicking it to second slip where Francois du Plessis takes a good low catch diving to his left. South Africa have the breakthrough that they wanted, the debutant's stay at the crease ends. First wicket in the match for Morris. England two down.
Good news for South Africa! Vernon Philander had an issue with his stomach in the morning but is back on the field for them.
Swinging back of a length ball on off and middle, Cook flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Back of length ball outside off, Westley defends it with soft hands towards point and they steal a quick run.
Starts off with a fuller ball outside off, which Westley doesn't bother playing.
We are back, with the sunny weather, and the players are making their way out. Morris will continue his unfinished over as Cook and Westley resume their vigil. Two slips and a gully in place.
...DAY 1, SESSION 2...

Only 22.1 overs were possible in this session and England have wrested back the early advantage that South Africa had. Jennings departed for a duck thanks to a Philander beauty. But from then, it has been the Cook-Westley show. They have been patient by leaving a lot of deliveries, but have also ensured that they keep the scoreboard ticking. Debutant Westley has been impressive due to the maturity that he has shown in playing the waiting game. Join us in a while for the post-lunch session, if and when the weather permits, where South Africa would try to end this stand as quickly as possible.
Bad news folks! The showers have come back again and the umpires have decided to call it an EARLY LUNCH. It seems like the players are going to have an on and off day.

Length ball outside off, Westley shoulders arms and lets it go.

Slight drizzle in the air.

Pitches outside off and comes in sharply, Cooky collects a single towards mid-wicket.
Alastair plays the leaving game as he shoulders arms to that length ball outside off.

Full ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
Sawdust being sprayed on the pitch next to the stumps. Philander is off the field, not sure of the reason though.
Full outside off and inviting a drive, Westley obliges and hits it through covers. They collect a brace as the fielder chases it down.
Length ball on off, Tom defends.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, Cook gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Length ball on off and going away, Alastair leaves it alone.
It has gone really dark. The artificial lights have been switched on. There are predictions of rain during the course of the day. Hope it does not play spoilsport.
Length ball outside off, Cook shoulders arms to that one.
Great ball from over the wicket. It just passes the poking bat of Alastair Cook.
Back of a length ball on off, Tom defends from within the crease.
Length ball on off, Westley drives it straight to covers.
Fuller ball on middle and off, AC collects a single towards mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! That's bowled on a fuller length on middle, Cook misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. Morris and the entire of South Africa appeals only to see it turned down by the on-field umpire. The Proteas think about that and Faf after consulting his bowler and de Kock decides to review. The Snicko reveals that there was a thin edge before the ball crashed into his pads. That saves Cook and the South Africans lose their first review.
South Africa have reviewed an LBW decision against Cook.
Full and swinging down the leg side, Cook tries to flick and misses.
Fuller ball on off, Cook defends it from within the crease.
Shortish ball outside off, Tom lets that go.
Back of length ball outside off, Westley defends it towards point.
Faf du Plessis is having a chat with Chris Morris regarding the field placements.
TW shoulders arms to that length ball outside off.
Directionless bouncer that! That started from middle and went down the leg as de Kock collected that. Such a waste of an effort.
Length ball on off, Tom defends it towards point.
Length ball on middle, Westley displays a solid defense from within the crease.
Length ball around leg stump, Cook looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards de Kock who dives to his right to collect it.
Full on off, Cook defends it towards point.
Full ball on off, Cook blocks it showing the full face of the bat.
Length ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.

Short and way down the leg side by Morris. Cook thinks of pulling but it is out of reach and a diving de Kock manages to get a glove on to that. The ball rolls away towards fine leg and the batsmen take a couple of byes.
Back of length ball outside off, Cook points his bat skywards as he lets it go through to the keeper.
Length ball outside off and Tom lets it go to the keeper.
Full outside off, Westley doesn't bother playing that.
Length ball outside off, Westley shoulders arms to that.
Full ball on middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on off and middle, Westley defends it off the front foot.
Bouncer by Rabada, Westley ducks under that one.
Full ball outside off and swinging away, Cook lets it go.
Full ball outside off, Cook pokes his bat and gets an edge. The ball goes on a bounce towards the gully region, where Kuhn and Elgar dive and bump into one another.
Full ball outside off, Cook shoulders arms.
Length ball way outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and outside off, AC has nothing to do with that.
Straight on target this! Fuller on off stump, Cook gets his bat down quickly in defense.
WIDE to start off! Round the wicket he bowls it way outside off on a good length. The umpire does some stretching of arms.
Chris Morris is now introduced into the attack. He starts with two slips and two gullies in place.
It's time for DRINKS now. England have played positive cricket after losing an early wicket. The Protea bowlers have largely been disciplined but not too threatening.
Fuller ball on off, Cook plays it with soft hands towards covers and the batsmen steal a quick single.
Length ball outside off, Cook shoulders arms.
Full and quick ball on leg, Cook misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Length ball outside off, AC leaves it alone.
Fuller ball outside off, Alastair lets it go to the keeper.
Length ball on middle, Cook defends it from within the crease.
Loopy ball on middle, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle and leg, Westley flicks it through mid-wicket. The player at mid on gives a valiant chase but is unable to cut it off. A boundary results.
Floated on off, defended bacl towards the bowler.
Flat ball outside off, Westley leaves it alone.
FOUR! Loopy ball a tad more outside off, Westley slaps that between covers and mid off for a boundary. Westley seems to be making his intentions against the spinner clear.
Starts off round the wicket with a slow loopy ball outside off. It's driven to mid off by Westley.
Spin as early as the 13th over in the match in the form of Keshav Maharaj.
Length ball on off, defended off the front foot by Cook.
Beaten! Cook feels for that length ball outside off and the ball just passes the outside edge.
Full ball on middle, hit straight to mid-wicket.
That's a length ball outside off, Cook shoulders arms.
Much better by Rabada as this was on middle and leg. Cook defends it back to the bowler from within the crease.
Rabada is bowling outside leg stump to Cook, who looks to flick but misses.

A loud shout for an LBW is denied! Full and swinging in to Westley, he goes for the flick but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. Morkel puts in an appeal but the umpire stays put. The replays confirm there was an inside edge.
Bowled on a length on his pads, Cook picks up a single towards fine leg.
Length ball sliding down the leg side, Cook tries to flick it and misses.
That's bowled just outside off on a back of length, Cook gets beaten.
Back of length ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
EDGED AND SAFE! Back of length ball on off , Cook is squared up as he tries to play it on the leg side. The ball takes the leading edge and runs through backward point for a couple.
Fuller ball in line of the stumps, Westley flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full and swinging away from Tom, he leaves it alone.
Again a back of a length ball on his pads, Cook collects a single towards fine leg.
FOUR! Just a slight correction and Cooky is too good to miss that! Full ball and bowled on his pads, the batsman flicks it and the ball races through square leg for a boundary.
This one is again full and down the leg side and the ball again thuds into de Kock's gloves after Cook misses his flick.
Full and swinging down the leg side, Cook misses the flick and the ball goes into the keeper's gloves.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl first change. He will be hungry to deliver after the one-match ban.
FOUR! Not the greatest of deliveries that. Full ball and sliding down leg, Westley just gets bat to ball and tickles it fine. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Now Westley is playing the shouldering-arms game by leaving yet another ball outside off.
Length ball outside off, Tom leaves it alone.
Another ball outside off, TW lets it go.
Fullish drivable ball outside off, Westley does so, but straight to covers.
Back of length ball well outside off stump, Tom lets it go.
Fullish ball on his pads, Cooky just flicks it away past the diving mid-wicket fielder. Bavuma gets up and chases it down and keeps it to a brace.
Good length ball outside off, Cook seems to be playing the well-left game pretty well here.
Fullish ball and too wide of off stump to make Cook play.
Length ball outside off, Cook raises his arms to leave the ball.
Another fullish ball outside off, Cook covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Full ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
Back of length ball outside off, the batsman shoulders arms.
Bouncer on off, Westley ducks under that.
Another fullish ball outside off and TW lets it go.
Length ball outside off and Westley doesn't bother fiddling with it.
Morkel bowls that outside off and swinging away, Tom leaves it alone.
FOUR! Westley gets going in Tests with a boundary. That is a full ball on middle and swinging in. He plays it with the angle through square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
Well left Cook! That was a length ball that started outside off and swung in late. The batsman judged it well and shouldered arms.
Straight and full ball on middle, Cook defends it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off going straight this time, Cook lets it go to the keeper.
Fullish ball outside off, Cook leaves it alone. The ball swung as it went to the keeper.
Bowled on a good length on off and middle, Cook pushes it to mid off.
Fullish ball on off, Cook defends it towards point for no run.
Fullish ball on leg, played straight to short leg. No run there.
Temba Bavuma comes under the lid at short leg.

FIVE RUNS! That was a full ball on off, Cook defends it off the front foot towards cover and sets off for a quick single. Kuhn stationed there has a shy at the non-striker's end. The throw is a wayward one and it passes wide of Philander who was backing up. The ball races away to the boundary.
Full ball on middle and off, Cook defends it towards mid-wicket.
Alastair shoulders arms to yet another full ball outside off.
Fullish outside off, Cook lets it go through to de Kock.
Back of length ball outside off, Cook shoulders arms to that. It moved in after passing the batsman.
This one was too close to the off stump to leave yet Westley does so.
Length ball outside off, Tom lets that go to de Kock.
A widish length ball outside off to welcome Westley at the crease, he leaves it alone.
Debutant Tom Westley walks out in the middle. Earlier than he would have liked.

OUT! Jennings' woes with the bat continue in this series. Philander  bowled it full on middle and off, the ball seamed away a bit. Jennings felt for the ball as he did earlier on a couple of occasions. This time though he ended up getting a thick edge and Dean Elgar stationed at third slip snapped up a good low catch diving to his right. England lose their first wicket after choosing to bat at the toss!
Length ball on middle, seams away after pitching. Keaton looks to play that and gets beaten.
Back of a length ball on leg, moving in slightly, Jennings showed his bat in defense but the ball struck him high on his pads and lobbed on the leg side.
Length ball on off, Cook defends it from within the crease.
Full ball on off, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beauty to come back! Back of a length ball on off, Cook gets beaten but the ball raps him on the box.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Cook here. This was bowled on a good length but on his pads, Cook flicks it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence. This was a punish-me ball and dutifully done so by Cooky!
FOUR! Shot! The classy Cook cover drive! That was full and outside off, the batsman presents the full face of the bat as he drives it crisply for a boundary. That would settle his nerves, if any.
Back of length ball starting from off and swinging into Cook. He missed it and the ball thudded into his thigh pads.
Full ball on middle and leg, Jennings pushes at it but gets it off the inner half to short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Jennings lets it go to de Kock.
Philander stopped in his delivery stride. May be, he lost his rhythm.
Shortish ball on off, Jennings feels for it and gets beaten.
Fullish ball outside off, Keaton leaves that alone.
Almost an action replay of the previous ball, Jennings doesn't bother doing anything with that.
Bowled from over the wicket, it was just outside off on a good length. A hint of inswing there as Jennings lets it go to the keeper.
Vernon Philander will share the new ball from the other end.
Back of length ball outside off, Cook lets it go.
Full ball on off, Cook defends and the ball rolls towards gully off the outer half of the bat.

FOUR! Cook and England get underway, courtesy a boundary through the slip cordon. That was full and just outside off, Cook feels for that and the thick edge carries the ball between the third slip and the gully fielder for a boundary.
Good ball, Cook's beaten there! That's a good length ball outside off, Cook is squared up in defense and the ball passes the outside edge and into the gloves of the keeper.
This is bowled on a good length on off and middle, Cook defends it solidly off the front foot.
Starts the match with a back of a length ball bowled well outside off, Cook just shoulders arms to that one.

The players and the umpires walk out in the middle. It seems to be a pleasant day for cricket. Alastair Cook and Keaton Jennings with bats in their hands walk out to open the innings for England. Morne Morkel to start the proceedings with the brand new red cherry for the Proteas. Three slips, a gully and a short leg in place. Here we go...
South Africa (Playing XI) - Dean Elgar, Heino Kuhn, Hashim Amla, Quinton de Kock(wk), Faf du Plessis(c), Temba Bavuma, Vernon Philander, Chris Morris, Keshav Maharaj, Kagiso Rabada, Morne Morkel.
England (Playing XI) - Alastair Cook, Keaton Jennings, Tom Westley, Joe Root(c), Dawid Malan, Ben Stokes, Jonny Bairstow(wk), Moeen Ali, Toby Roland-Jones, Stuart Broad, James Anderson.

TOSS - England win the toss and opt to bat. The home side have made three changes. Gary Ballance, Mark Wood and Liam Dawson make way for the debutants, TOM WESTLEY, TOBY ROLAND-JONES and DAWID MALAN. On the other hand, South Africa have made one change. KAGISO RABADA comes in for Duanne Olivier.

What has not aided England is the lack of form coupled with injuries to some of their key players, which suggests that it's a confused dressing room. South Africa, on the other hand have a settled side, and the only change that is expected is Kagiso Rabada, who would walk in after serving his one-match suspension, in place of Duanne Olivier. There seems to be an exciting match in store for us as the series is squared up at 1-1, and both teams would be vying for that edge going into the final Test. Stay with us for the toss!

Hello and a warm welcome for our coverage of the third Test between England and South Africa. This is a historic Test for the reason that it is the 100th Test match at The Oval, London. Historically, England have the edge over the Proteas at this venue, as they have won 6 of the 7 games that they have played against them. However, if momentum is something in sport, it is well with the African tourists coming into this match on the back of a thumping win at Trent Bridge.
